1	# TASK: the media library (own section, source-agnostic)
2	
3	The pick flow is still a pair of text links inside the join card: `Choose file…` and `Jellyfin`. That
4	was enough to prove sync; it is not where media should live. Give picking its own section — a browse
5	surface that shows what is available, feels like a library, and is built to carry music and YouTube
6	next without being rebuilt.
7	
8	## Shape
9	
10	**A. Model first (this is the part that must survive).**
11	
12	```
13	enum MediaKind { video, audio, live }        // live = a stream/URL
14	enum MediaSourceKind { local, jellyfin, youtube, ytm }
15	
16	class MediaItem {
17	  String ref;                 // the item_ref that goes on the wire, unchanged
18	  String title;
19	  String? subtitle;           // artist/album, show/season, channel
20	  MediaKind kind;
21	  MediaSourceKind source;
22	  Duration? duration;
23	  String? posterUrl;          // http(s) for Jellyfin; null for local files
24	  double? aspect;             // poster vs square art later
25	}
26	
27	abstract class MediaSource {
28	  MediaSourceKind get kind;
29	  String get label;                       // "This computer", "Jellyfin", "YouTube"
30	  bool get ready;                          // signed in / available
31	  Future<List<MediaItem>> browse({String query = ''});
32	  Future<void> ensureReady();             // sign-in flow, if any
33	}
34	```
35	
36	`ref` is what the room already understands (`file:sha256p:…`, `jellyfin:<host>/<id>`), so nothing on the
37	server or in the sync engine changes. Music will add `subsonic:…`/`ytm:…` refs later — the UI must
38	never assume video.
39	
40	**B. The library screen.**
41	
42	- Full-height surface with its own header: title, a search field, and source tabs built from the
43	  registered sources (`This computer`, `Jellyfin`, and — visibly disabled with a `Soon` tag —
44	  `YouTube`, `Music`). Do not hard-code the tabs; iterate the source list.
45	- Content: a responsive grid of cards. Jellyfin items show their poster (`{server}/Items/{id}/Images/
46	  Primary?maxHeight=300&api_key=…`, verified working); local files show a file glyph plus the size and
47	  runtime. Card shows title, subtitle, duration; hover reveals `Play` and `Queue` actions.
48	- Empty states per source: not signed in (`Connect Jellyfin`), signed in but empty (`Nothing in this
49	  library yet`), and no search results.
50	- Keyboard: `/` focuses search, `Esc` closes, arrows move, `Enter` plays. Pointer does everything too.
51	- One badge per card for the kind (film / note / broadcast) so music and live items are legible before
52	  the adapters exist.
53	
54	**C. Where it is reachable from.**
55	
56	- Home: replace `Choose file…` / `Jellyfin` inline links with one `Pick media` action that opens the
57	  library; keep drag-and-drop of a local file as the fast path. Choosing an item sets the room copy the
58	  same way today's pickers do.
59	- Room: the queue's `Add` opens the library in **queue mode** (a `Queue this` action instead of `Play`,
60	  and no closing on pick so several can be added).
61	- A `Library` entry in the Home brand column so the section is reachable on its own, not only mid-join.
62	
63	**D. Diagrams of intent, not a rewrite.** The existing Jellyfin dialog becomes the sign-in form inside
64	the library's Jellyfin source (`ensureReady`). Local file picking stays the OS dialog when the user has
65	no library to browse.
66	
67	## Constraints
68	
69	- No protocol, clock, drift, or intent changes; `item_ref` formats stay as they are.
70	- Candy palette and the existing widget vocabulary; no new fonts or packages.
71	- Tests: model/ref round-trip for both sources, tab list honours registered sources, search filters,
72	  empty states, queue mode does not close on pick, and the keyboard paths. Goldens: library with
73	  Jellyfin posters and library in queue mode, at 1440×900 and 856×1038.
74	- `flutter test` green, `flutter analyze` no new issues, `flutter build linux --debug` passes.
75	
76	## Do not
77	
78	- Do not invent a YouTube or music adapter in this pass. Disabled tabs and the model are the whole
79	  point; shipping a stub that lies is worse than an honest `Soon`.
80	
81	Report: the model as built, how sources register, screenshots/golden paths, test count, and the parts you
82	deliberately deferred.

# TASK: the media library (own section, source-agnostic)

The pick flow is still a pair of text links inside the join card: `Choose file…` and `Jellyfin`. That
was enough to prove sync; it is not where media should live. Give picking its own section — a browse
surface that shows what is available, feels like a library, and is built to carry music and YouTube
next without being rebuilt.

## Shape

**A. Model first (this is the part that must survive).**

```
enum MediaKind { video, audio, live }        // live = a stream/URL
enum MediaSourceKind { local, jellyfin, youtube, ytm }

class MediaItem {
  String ref;                 // the item_ref that goes on the wire, unchanged
  String title;
  String? subtitle;           // artist/album, show/season, channel
  MediaKind kind;
  MediaSourceKind source;
  Duration? duration;
  String? posterUrl;          // http(s) for Jellyfin; null for local files
  double? aspect;             // poster vs square art later
}

abstract class MediaSource {
  MediaSourceKind get kind;
  String get label;                       // "This computer", "Jellyfin", "YouTube"
  bool get ready;                          // signed in / available
  Future<List<MediaItem>> browse({String query = ''});
  Future<void> ensureReady();             // sign-in flow, if any
}
```

`ref` is what the room already understands (`file:sha256p:…`, `jellyfin:<host>/<id>`), so nothing on the
server or in the sync engine changes. Music will add `subsonic:…`/`ytm:…` refs later — the UI must
never assume video.

**B. The library screen.**

- Full-height surface with its own header: title, a search field, and source tabs built from the
  registered sources (`This computer`, `Jellyfin`, and — visibly disabled with a `Soon` tag —
  `YouTube`, `Music`). Do not hard-code the tabs; iterate the source list.
- Content: a responsive grid of cards. Jellyfin items show their poster (`{server}/Items/{id}/Images/
  Primary?maxHeight=300&api_key=…`, verified working); local files show a file glyph plus the size and
  runtime. Card shows title, subtitle, duration; hover reveals `Play` and `Queue` actions.
- Empty states per source: not signed in (`Connect Jellyfin`), signed in but empty (`Nothing in this
  library yet`), and no search results.
- Keyboard: `/` focuses search, `Esc` closes, arrows move, `Enter` plays. Pointer does everything too.
- One badge per card for the kind (film / note / broadcast) so music and live items are legible before
  the adapters exist.

**C. Where it is reachable from.**

- Home: replace `Choose file…` / `Jellyfin` inline links with one `Pick media` action that opens the
  library; keep drag-and-drop of a local file as the fast path. Choosing an item sets the room copy the
  same way today's pickers do.
- Room: the queue's `Add` opens the library in **queue mode** (a `Queue this` action instead of `Play`,
  and no closing on pick so several can be added).
- A `Library` entry in the Home brand column so the section is reachable on its own, not only mid-join.

**D. Diagrams of intent, not a rewrite.** The existing Jellyfin dialog becomes the sign-in form inside
the library's Jellyfin source (`ensureReady`). Local file picking stays the OS dialog when the user has
no library to browse.

## Constraints

- No protocol, clock, drift, or intent changes; `item_ref` formats stay as they are.
- Candy palette and the existing widget vocabulary; no new fonts or packages.
- Tests: model/ref round-trip for both sources, tab list honours registered sources, search filters,
  empty states, queue mode does not close on pick, and the keyboard paths. Goldens: library with
  Jellyfin posters and library in queue mode, at 1440×900 and 856×1038.
- `flutter test` green, `flutter analyze` no new issues, `flutter build linux --debug` passes.

## Do not

- Do not invent a YouTube or music adapter in this pass. Disabled tabs and the model are the whole
  point; shipping a stub that lies is worse than an honest `Soon`.

Report: the model as built, how sources register, screenshots/golden paths, test count, and the parts you
deliberately deferred.

# TASK: the queue must accept Jellyfin items too

Found by the owner: `QUEUE → Add` only opens the local file picker. `RoomScreen._addToQueue` calls
`widget.pickCopy()` and nothing else, so a room whose media lives on Jellyfin cannot queue anything —
even though the same screen already carries a working `pickJellyfin` picker for the now-playing copy.

## What to change

1. **`Add` becomes a choice.** Tapping `Add` opens a small menu with two entries:
   - `From this computer` → the existing `pickCopy()`
   - `From Jellyfin` → `pickJellyfin()`, hidden when that callback is null
   Do not add a second button to the rail header; a two-item menu keeps the row quiet.
2. **One path from there.** Both routes end in the same `queue_add` intent with the item's `item_ref`,
   and both record the display name and duration in `_known` so the row renders properly.
3. **Rows say where they came from.** Queue rows get the same `Jellyfin` / `Local file` source chip the
   now-playing row uses, derived from the ref (`jellyfin:` prefix), not from a stored flag that can
   drift.
4. **Same for the queue's empty-state hint** if it assumes a file: "Add the next episode…" should work
   for either source.

## Also close this, if the immersive-fullscreen task did not

An **always-visible** `Exit fullscreen` control in fullscreen (low contrast, never auto-hidden) plus a
`Show controls` toggle — the owner does not want to wait for chrome to fade back in. Check
`lib/room_view.dart` first; if TASK19 already added a persistent one, say so and skip.

## Constraints

- No protocol or intent changes (`queue_add` already takes any `item_ref`).
- Reuse existing menu/widget vocabulary.
- Widget tests: the menu offers both entries when a Jellyfin picker exists, only the file entry when it
  does not, and a Jellyfin-queued item reaches `onAddToQueue`'s send path with its ref intact (fake the
  client or assert the recorded `_known` entry).
- `flutter test` green, `flutter analyze` no new issues, `flutter build linux --debug` passes.

Report: files, how the menu is built, test count.

26	          right: -5,
27	          bottom: -5,

41	/// Shared interaction for every tappable surface: click cursor, Enter activates,
42	/// pressed scale .96 over 120 ms, focus ring, 40% when disabled.
43	class WtTap extends StatefulWidget {
44	  const WtTap({
45	    super.key,
46	    required this.child,
47	    required this.onTap,
48	    this.radius = WtRadius.control,
49	    this.tooltip,
50	    this.semanticLabel,
51	    this.dimWhenDisabled = true,
52	  });
53	  final Widget child;
54	  final VoidCallback? onTap;
55	  final double radius;
56	  final String? tooltip;
57	  final String? semanticLabel;
58	  final bool dimWhenDisabled;
59	
60	  @override
61	  State<WtTap> createState() => _WtTapState();
62	}
63	
64	class _WtTapState extends State<WtTap> {
65	  bool _focused = false;
66	  bool _pressed = false;
67	
68	  void _press(bool value) {
69	    if (_pressed != value) setState(() => _pressed = value);
70	  }
71	
72	  @override
73	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
74	    final enabled = widget.onTap != null;
75	    Widget child = FocusableActionDetector(
76	      enabled: enabled,
77	      mouseCursor: enabled ? SystemMouseCursors.click : MouseCursor.defer,
78	      onShowFocusHighlight: (v) => setState(() => _focused = v),
79	      actions: {
80	        ActivateIntent: CallbackAction<ActivateIntent>(
81	          onInvoke: (_) {
82	            widget.onTap?.call();
83	            return null;
84	          },
85	        ),
86	      },
87	      child: GestureDetector(
88	        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
89	        onTapDown: enabled ? (_) => _press(true) : null,
90	        onTapUp: enabled ? (_) => _press(false) : null,
91	        onTapCancel: () => _press(false),
92	        onTap: widget.onTap,
93	        child: AnimatedScale(
94	          scale: _pressed ? 0.96 : 1,
95	          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 120),
96	          curve: Curves.easeOut,
97	          child: WtFocusRing(
98	            show: _focused && enabled,
99	            radius: widget.radius,
100	            child: widget.child,
101	          ),
102	        ),
103	      ),
104	    );
105	    child = Semantics(
106	      button: true,
107	      enabled: enabled,
108	      label: widget.semanticLabel,
109	      child: child,
110	    );
111	    if (widget.tooltip != null) {
112	      child = Tooltip(message: widget.tooltip!, child: child);
113	    }
114	    return widget.dimWhenDisabled && !enabled
115	        ? Opacity(opacity: 0.4, child: child)
116	        : child;
117	  }
118	}

181	          color: primary ? const Color(0x3DFFFFFF) : WtColors.line,
182	          width: 2,
183	        ),

186	      child: Row(
187	        mainAxisSize: fullWidth ? MainAxisSize.max : MainAxisSize.min,
188	        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
189	        children: [

191	            Icon(icon, size: font + 3, color: WtColors.text),
192	            const SizedBox(width: 8),
193	          ],
194	          Flexible(
195	            child: Text(
196	              label,
197	              maxLines: 1,

200	                fontSize: font,
201	                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
202	                color: WtColors.text,
203	              ),
204	            ),
205	          ),
206	          if (trailingIcon != null) ...[
207	            const SizedBox(width: 10),

210	        ],
211	      ),
212	    );
213	    return WtTap(
214	      onTap: onPressed,

5	/// Board avatars: `.av-a` pink, `.av-b` violet, `.av-c` light.
6	enum _Swatch { pink, violet, light }
7	
8	_Swatch _swatch(String id) {
9	  var hash = 0;
10	  for (final c in id.codeUnits) {
11	    hash = (hash * 31 + c) & 0x7fffffff;
12	  }
13	  return _Swatch.values[hash % 3];
14	}
15	
16	class WtAvatar extends StatelessWidget {
17	  const WtAvatar({
18	    super.key,
19	    required this.id,
20	    required this.name,
21	    this.size = 36,
22	    this.ring = WtColors.plum2,
23	    this.muted = false,
24	  });
25	  final String id;
26	  final String name;
27	  final double size;
28	  final Color ring;
29	
30	  /// Board `.av-d`: someone not ready yet.
31	  final bool muted;
32	
33	  @override
34	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
35	    final swatch = _swatch(id);
36	    return Container(
37	      width: size,
38	      height: size,
39	      alignment: Alignment.center,
40	      decoration: BoxDecoration(
41	        shape: BoxShape.circle,
42	        border: Border.all(color: ring, width: 2),
43	        color: muted
44	            ? WtColors.s2
45	            : swatch == _Swatch.light
46	            ? const Color(0xFFFFE6F3)
47	            : null,
48	        gradient: muted
49	            ? null
50	            : switch (swatch) {
51	                _Swatch.pink => const LinearGradient(
52	                  begin: Alignment.topLeft,
53	                  end: Alignment.bottomRight,
54	                  colors: [Color(0xFFFF92C9), Color(0xFFD93583)],
55	                ),
56	                _Swatch.violet => const LinearGradient(
57	                  begin: Alignment.topLeft,
58	                  end: Alignment.bottomRight,
59	                  colors: [Color(0xFFB49BFF), Color(0xFF6A45F2)],
60	                ),
61	                _Swatch.light => null,
62	              },
63	      ),
64	      child: Text(
65	        name.trim().isEmpty ? '?' : name.trim()[0].toUpperCase(),
66	        style: TextStyle(
67	          color: muted
68	              ? WtColors.tx3
69	              : swatch == _Swatch.light
70	              ? const Color(0xFF4A1F55)
71	              : Colors.white,
72	          fontSize: size * 0.4,
73	          height: 1,
74	          fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
75	        ),
76	      ),
77	    );
78	  }
79	}

81	/// Overlapping avatars, board `.stack`; extra people collapse into `+N`.
82	class WtAvatarStack extends StatelessWidget {
83	  const WtAvatarStack({
84	    super.key,
85	    required this.people,
86	    this.extra = 0,
87	    this.size = 30,
88	    this.ring = WtColors.plum,
89	  });
90	
91	  /// `(id, name)` pairs.
92	  final List<(String, String)> people;
93	  final int extra;
94	  final double size;
95	  final Color ring;
96	
97	  @override
98	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
99	    final shown = people.take(3).toList();
100	    final more = extra + people.length - shown.length;
101	    final count = shown.length + (more > 0 ? 1 : 0);
102	    if (count == 0) return const SizedBox.shrink();
103	    final step = size - 8;
104	    return SizedBox(
105	      width: size + (count - 1) * step,
106	      height: size,
107	      child: Stack(
108	        children: [
109	          for (var i = 0; i < shown.length; i++)
110	            Positioned(
111	              left: i * step,
112	              child: WtAvatar(
113	                id: shown[i].$1,
114	                name: shown[i].$2,
115	                size: size,
116	                ring: ring,
117	              ),
118	            ),
119	          if (more > 0)
120	            Positioned(
121	              left: shown.length * step,
122	              child: Container(
123	                width: size,
124	                height: size,
125	                alignment: Alignment.center,
126	                decoration: BoxDecoration(
127	                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
128	                  color: WtColors.s2,
129	                  border: Border.all(color: ring, width: 2),
130	                ),
131	                child: Text(
132	                  '+$more',
133	                  style: TextStyle(
134	                    fontSize: size * 0.36,
135	                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
136	                    color: WtColors.tx2,
137	                  ),
138	                ),
139	              ),
140	            ),
141	        ],
142	      ),
143	    );
144	  }
145	}

# TASK: the media library (own section, source-agnostic)

The pick flow is still a pair of text links inside the join card: `Choose file…` and `Jellyfin`. That
was enough to prove sync; it is not where media should live. Give picking its own section — a browse
surface that shows what is available, feels like a library, and is built to carry music and YouTube
next without being rebuilt.

## Shape

**A. Model first (this is the part that must survive).**

```
enum MediaKind { video, audio, live }        // live = a stream/URL
enum MediaSourceKind { local, jellyfin, youtube, ytm }

class MediaItem {
  String ref;                 // the item_ref that goes on the wire, unchanged
  String title;
  String? subtitle;           // artist/album, show/season, channel
  MediaKind kind;
  MediaSourceKind source;
  Duration? duration;
  String? posterUrl;          // http(s) for Jellyfin; null for local files
  double? aspect;             // poster vs square art later
}

abstract class MediaSource {
  MediaSourceKind get kind;
  String get label;                       // "This computer", "Jellyfin", "YouTube"
  bool get ready;                          // signed in / available
  Future<List<MediaItem>> browse({String query = ''});
  Future<void> ensureReady();             // sign-in flow, if any
}
```

`ref` is what the room already understands (`file:sha256p:…`, `jellyfin:<host>/<id>`), so nothing on the
server or in the sync engine changes. Music will add `subsonic:…`/`ytm:…` refs later — the UI must
never assume video.

**B. The library screen.**

- Full-height surface with its own header: title, a search field, and source tabs built from the
  registered sources (`This computer`, `Jellyfin`, and — visibly disabled with a `Soon` tag —
  `YouTube`, `Music`). Do not hard-code the tabs; iterate the source list.
- Content: a responsive grid of cards. Jellyfin items show their poster (`{server}/Items/{id}/Images/
  Primary?maxHeight=300&api_key=…`, verified working); local files show a file glyph plus the size and
  runtime. Card shows title, subtitle, duration; hover reveals `Play` and `Queue` actions.
- Empty states per source: not signed in (`Connect Jellyfin`), signed in but empty (`Nothing in this
  library yet`), and no search results.
- Keyboard: `/` focuses search, `Esc` closes, arrows move, `Enter` plays. Pointer does everything too.
- One badge per card for the kind (film / note / broadcast) so music and live items are legible before
  the adapters exist.

**C. Where it is reachable from.**

- Home: replace `Choose file…` / `Jellyfin` inline links with one `Pick media` action that opens the
  library; keep drag-and-drop of a local file as the fast path. Choosing an item sets the room copy the
  same way today's pickers do.
- Room: the queue's `Add` opens the library in **queue mode** (a `Queue this` action instead of `Play`,
  and no closing on pick so several can be added).
- A `Library` entry in the Home brand column so the section is reachable on its own, not only mid-join.

**D. Diagrams of intent, not a rewrite.** The existing Jellyfin dialog becomes the sign-in form inside
the library's Jellyfin source (`ensureReady`). Local file picking stays the OS dialog when the user has
no library to browse.

## Constraints

- No protocol, clock, drift, or intent changes; `item_ref` formats stay as they are.
- Candy palette and the existing widget vocabulary; no new fonts or packages.
- Tests: model/ref round-trip for both sources, tab list honours registered sources, search filters,
  empty states, queue mode does not close on pick, and the keyboard paths. Goldens: library with
  Jellyfin posters and library in queue mode, at 1440×900 and 856×1038.
- `flutter test` green, `flutter analyze` no new issues, `flutter build linux --debug` passes.

## Do not

- Do not invent a YouTube or music adapter in this pass. Disabled tabs and the model are the whole
  point; shipping a stub that lies is worse than an honest `Soon`.

Report: the model as built, how sources register, screenshots/golden paths, test count, and the parts you
deliberately deferred.

41	/// Shared interaction for every tappable surface: click cursor, Enter activates,
42	/// pressed scale .96 over 120 ms, focus ring, 40% when disabled.
43	class WtTap extends StatefulWidget {
44	  const WtTap({
45	    super.key,
46	    required this.child,
47	    required this.onTap,
48	    this.radius = WtRadius.control,
49	    this.tooltip,
50	    this.semanticLabel,
51	    this.dimWhenDisabled = true,
52	  });
53	  final Widget child;
54	  final VoidCallback? onTap;
55	  final double radius;
56	  final String? tooltip;
57	  final String? semanticLabel;
58	  final bool dimWhenDisabled;
59	
60	  @override
61	  State<WtTap> createState() => _WtTapState();
62	}

64	class _WtTapState extends State<WtTap> {
65	  bool _focused = false;
66	  bool _pressed = false;
67	
68	  void _press(bool value) {
69	    if (_pressed != value) setState(() => _pressed = value);
70	  }
71	
72	  @override
73	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
74	    final enabled = widget.onTap != null;
75	    Widget child = FocusableActionDetector(
76	      enabled: enabled,
77	      mouseCursor: enabled ? SystemMouseCursors.click : MouseCursor.defer,
78	      onShowFocusHighlight: (v) => setState(() => _focused = v),
79	      actions: {
80	        ActivateIntent: CallbackAction<ActivateIntent>(
81	          onInvoke: (_) {
82	            widget.onTap?.call();
83	            return null;
84	          },
85	        ),
86	      },
87	      child: GestureDetector(
88	        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
89	        onTapDown: enabled ? (_) => _press(true) : null,
90	        onTapUp: enabled ? (_) => _press(false) : null,
91	        onTapCancel: () => _press(false),
92	        onTap: widget.onTap,
93	        child: AnimatedScale(
94	          scale: _pressed ? 0.96 : 1,
95	          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 120),
96	          curve: Curves.easeOut,
97	          child: WtFocusRing(
98	            show: _focused && enabled,
99	            radius: widget.radius,
100	            child: widget.child,
101	          ),
102	        ),
103	      ),
104	    );
105	    child = Semantics(
106	      button: true,
107	      enabled: enabled,
108	      label: widget.semanticLabel,
109	      child: child,
110	    );
111	    if (widget.tooltip != null) {
112	      child = Tooltip(message: widget.tooltip!, child: child);
113	    }
114	    return widget.dimWhenDisabled && !enabled
115	        ? Opacity(opacity: 0.4, child: child)
116	        : child;
117	  }
118	}

143	class WtButton extends StatelessWidget {

155	  final String label;

186	      child: Row(
187	        mainAxisSize: fullWidth ? MainAxisSize.max : MainAxisSize.min,
188	        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
189	        children: [
190	          if (icon != null) ...[
191	            Icon(icon, size: font + 3, color: WtColors.text),
192	            const SizedBox(width: 8),
193	          ],
194	          Flexible(
195	            child: Text(
196	              label,
197	              maxLines: 1,
198	              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
199	              style: TextStyle(
200	                fontSize: font,
201	                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
202	                color: WtColors.text,
203	              ),
204	            ),
205	          ),
206	          if (trailingIcon != null) ...[
207	            const SizedBox(width: 10),
208	            Icon(trailingIcon, size: font + 5, color: WtColors.text),
209	          ],
210	        ],
211	      ),
212	    );
213	    return WtTap(
214	      onTap: onPressed,
215	      radius: radius,
216	      tooltip: tooltip,
217	      child: primary ? WtInsetHighlight(radius: radius, child: content) : content,
218	    );
219	  }
220	}

1	# TASK: the media library (own section, source-agnostic)
2	
3	The pick flow is still a pair of text links inside the join card: `Choose file…` and `Jellyfin`. That
4	was enough to prove sync; it is not where media should live. Give picking its own section — a browse
5	surface that shows what is available, feels like a library, and is built to carry music and YouTube
6	next without being rebuilt.
7	
8	## Shape
9	
10	**A. Model first (this is the part that must survive).**
11	
12	```
13	enum MediaKind { video, audio, live }        // live = a stream/URL
14	enum MediaSourceKind { local, jellyfin, youtube, ytm }
15	
16	class MediaItem {
17	  String ref;                 // the item_ref that goes on the wire, unchanged
18	  String title;
19	  String? subtitle;           // artist/album, show/season, channel
20	  MediaKind kind;
21	  MediaSourceKind source;
22	  Duration? duration;
23	  String? posterUrl;          // http(s) for Jellyfin; null for local files
24	  double? aspect;             // poster vs square art later
25	}
26	
27	abstract class MediaSource {
28	  MediaSourceKind get kind;
29	  String get label;                       // "This computer", "Jellyfin", "YouTube"
30	  bool get ready;                          // signed in / available
31	  Future<List<MediaItem>> browse({String query = ''});
32	  Future<void> ensureReady();             // sign-in flow, if any
33	}
34	```
35	
36	`ref` is what the room already understands (`file:sha256p:…`, `jellyfin:<host>/<id>`), so nothing on the
37	server or in the sync engine changes. Music will add `subsonic:…`/`ytm:…` refs later — the UI must
38	never assume video.
39	
40	**B. The library screen.**
41	
42	- Full-height surface with its own header: title, a search field, and source tabs built from the
43	  registered sources (`This computer`, `Jellyfin`, and — visibly disabled with a `Soon` tag —
44	  `YouTube`, `Music`). Do not hard-code the tabs; iterate the source list.
45	- Content: a responsive grid of cards. Jellyfin items show their poster (`{server}/Items/{id}/Images/
46	  Primary?maxHeight=300&api_key=…`, verified working); local files show a file glyph plus the size and
47	  runtime. Card shows title, subtitle, duration; hover reveals `Play` and `Queue` actions.
48	- Empty states per source: not signed in (`Connect Jellyfin`), signed in but empty (`Nothing in this
49	  library yet`), and no search results.
50	- Keyboard: `/` focuses search, `Esc` closes, arrows move, `Enter` plays. Pointer does everything too.
51	- One badge per card for the kind (film / note / broadcast) so music and live items are legible before
52	  the adapters exist.
53	
54	**C. Where it is reachable from.**
55	
56	- Home: replace `Choose file…` / `Jellyfin` inline links with one `Pick media` action that opens the
57	  library; keep drag-and-drop of a local file as the fast path. Choosing an item sets the room copy the
58	  same way today's pickers do.
59	- Room: the queue's `Add` opens the library in **queue mode** (a `Queue this` action instead of `Play`,
60	  and no closing on pick so several can be added).
61	- A `Library` entry in the Home brand column so the section is reachable on its own, not only mid-join.
62	
63	**D. Diagrams of intent, not a rewrite.** The existing Jellyfin dialog becomes the sign-in form inside
64	the library's Jellyfin source (`ensureReady`). Local file picking stays the OS dialog when the user has
65	no library to browse.
66	
67	## Constraints
68	
69	- No protocol, clock, drift, or intent changes; `item_ref` formats stay as they are.
70	- Candy palette and the existing widget vocabulary; no new fonts or packages.
71	- Tests: model/ref round-trip for both sources, tab list honours registered sources, search filters,
72	  empty states, queue mode does not close on pick, and the keyboard paths. Goldens: library with
73	  Jellyfin posters and library in queue mode, at 1440×900 and 856×1038.
74	- `flutter test` green, `flutter analyze` no new issues, `flutter build linux --debug` passes.
75	
76	## Do not
77	
78	- Do not invent a YouTube or music adapter in this pass. Disabled tabs and the model are the whole
79	  point; shipping a stub that lies is worse than an honest `Soon`.
80	
81	Report: the model as built, how sources register, screenshots/golden paths, test count, and the parts you
82	deliberately deferred.
83

was enough to prove sync; it is not where media should live. Give picking its own section — a browse

## Shape

**A. Model first (this is the part that must survive).**

```
enum MediaKind { video, audio, live }        // live = a stream/URL
enum MediaSourceKind { local, jellyfin, youtube, ytm }

class MediaItem {
  String ref;                 // the item_ref that goes on the wire, unchanged
  String title;
  String? subtitle;           // artist/album, show/season, channel
  MediaKind kind;
  MediaSourceKind source;
  Duration? duration;
  String? posterUrl;          // http(s) for Jellyfin; null for local files
  double? aspect;             // poster vs square art later
}

abstract class MediaSource {
  MediaSourceKind get kind;
  String get label;                       // "This computer", "Jellyfin", "YouTube"
  bool get ready;                          // signed in / available
  Future<List<MediaItem>> browse({String query = ''});
  Future<void> ensureReady();             // sign-in flow, if any
}
```

`ref` is what the room already understands (`file:sha256p:…`, `jellyfin:<host>/<id>`), so nothing on the
server or in the sync engine changes. Music will add `subsonic:…`/`ytm:…` refs later — the UI must
never assume video.

**B. The library screen.**

- Full-height surface with its own header: title, a search field, and source tabs built from the
  registered sources (`This computer`, `Jellyfin`, and — visibly disabled with a `Soon` tag —
  `YouTube`, `Music`). Do not hard-code the tabs; iterate the source list.
- Content: a responsive grid of cards. Jellyfin items show their poster (`{server}/Items/{id}/Images/
  Primary?maxHeight=300&api_key=…`, verified working); local files show a file glyph plus the size and
  runtime. Card shows title, subtitle, duration; hover reveals `Play` and `Queue` actions.
- Empty states per source: not signed in (`Connect Jellyfin`), signed in but empty (`Nothing in this
  library yet`), and no search results.
- Keyboard: `/` focuses search, `Esc` closes, arrows move, `Enter` plays. Pointer does everything too.
- One badge per card for the kind (film / note / broadcast) so music and live items are legible before
  the adapters exist.

**C. Where it is reachable from.**

- Home: replace `Choose file…` / `Jellyfin` inline links with one `Pick media` action that opens the
  library; keep drag-and-drop of a local file as the fast path. Choosing an item sets the room copy the
  same way today's pickers do.
- Room: the queue's `Add` opens the library in **queue mode** (a `Queue this` action instead of `Play`,
  and no closing on pick so several can be added).
- A `Library` entry in the Home brand column so the section is reachable on its own, not only mid-join.

**D. Diagrams of intent, not a rewrite.** The existing Jellyfin dialog becomes the sign-in form inside
the library's Jellyfin source (`ensureReady`). Local file picking stays the OS dialog when the user has
no library to browse.

## Constraints

- No protocol, clock, drift, or intent changes; `item_ref` formats stay as they are.
- Candy palette and the existing widget vocabulary; no new fonts or packages.
- Tests: model/ref round-trip for both sources, tab list honours registered sources, search filters,
  empty states, queue mode does not close on pick, and the keyboard paths. Goldens: library with
  Jellyfin posters and library in queue mode, at 1440×900 and 856×1038.
- `flutter test` green, `flutter analyze` no new issues, `flutter build linux --debug` passes.

## Do not

- Do not invent a YouTube or music adapter in this pass. Disabled tabs and the model are the whole
  point; shipping a stub that lies is worse than an honest `Soon`.

Report: the model as built, how sources register, screenshots/golden paths, test count, and the parts you
deliberately deferred.

12	/// Resolves to the new session, or null when closed. [previous] pre-fills server and user.
13	Future<JellyfinSession?> showJellyfinSignIn(
14	  BuildContext context, {
15	  required JellyfinApi api,
16	  JellyfinSession? previous,
17	}) => showDialog<JellyfinSession>(
18	  context: context,
19	  barrierColor: const Color(0x8C000000),
20	  builder: (_) => JellyfinDialog(api: api, previous: previous),
21	);
22	
23	class JellyfinDialog extends StatefulWidget {
24	  const JellyfinDialog({super.key, required this.api, this.previous});
25	  final JellyfinApi api;
26	  final JellyfinSession? previous;
27	
28	  @override
29	  State<JellyfinDialog> createState() => _JellyfinDialogState();
30	}
31	
32	class _JellyfinDialogState extends State<JellyfinDialog> {
33	  late final _server = TextEditingController(
34	    text: widget.previous?.server.toString() ?? '',
35	  );
36	  late final _user = TextEditingController(text: widget.previous?.user ?? '');
37	  final _pass = TextEditingController();
38	  bool _busy = false;
39	  String? _error;
40	
41	  static const _muted = TextStyle(
42	    fontSize: 14,
43	    fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
44	    color: WtColors.tx3,
45	  );
46	
47	  @override
48	  void dispose() {
49	    _server.dispose();
50	    _user.dispose();
51	    _pass.dispose();
52	    super.dispose();
53	  }
54	
55	  Future<void> _connect() async {
56	    final problem =
57	        validateJellyfinServer(_server.text) ??
58	        (_user.text.trim().isEmpty ? 'Enter your Jellyfin user name' : null);
59	    if (problem != null) {
60	      setState(() => _error = problem);
61	      return;
62	    }
63	    setState(() {
64	      _busy = true;
65	      _error = null;
66	    });
67	    try {
68	      final session = await widget.api.connect(
69	        server: Uri.parse(_server.text.trim()),
70	        user: _user.text.trim(),
71	        pass: _pass.text,
72	      );
73	      if (mounted) Navigator.of(context).pop(session);
74	    } on Object catch (e) {
75	      if (mounted) {
76	        setState(() {
77	          _busy = false;
78	          _error = '$e';

117	              'The room only shares which movie.',

# TASK: the media library (own section, source-agnostic)

The pick flow is still a pair of text links inside the join card: `Choose file…` and `Jellyfin`. That
was enough to prove sync; it is not where media should live. Give picking its own section — a browse
surface that shows what is available, feels like a library, and is built to carry music and YouTube
next without being rebuilt.

## Shape

**A. Model first (this is the part that must survive).**

```
enum MediaKind { video, audio, live }        // live = a stream/URL
enum MediaSourceKind { local, jellyfin, youtube, ytm }

class MediaItem {
  String ref;                 // the item_ref that goes on the wire, unchanged
  String title;
  String? subtitle;           // artist/album, show/season, channel
  MediaKind kind;
  MediaSourceKind source;
  Duration? duration;
  String? posterUrl;          // http(s) for Jellyfin; null for local files
  double? aspect;             // poster vs square art later
}

abstract class MediaSource {
  MediaSourceKind get kind;
  String get label;                       // "This computer", "Jellyfin", "YouTube"
  bool get ready;                          // signed in / available
  Future<List<MediaItem>> browse({String query = ''});
  Future<void> ensureReady();             // sign-in flow, if any
}
```

`ref` is what the room already understands (`file:sha256p:…`, `jellyfin:<host>/<id>`), so nothing on the
server or in the sync engine changes. Music will add `subsonic:…`/`ytm:…` refs later — the UI must
never assume video.

**B. The library screen.**

- Full-height surface with its own header: title, a search field, and source tabs built from the
  registered sources (`This computer`, `Jellyfin`, and — visibly disabled with a `Soon` tag —
  `YouTube`, `Music`). Do not hard-code the tabs; iterate the source list.
- Content: a responsive grid of cards. Jellyfin items show their poster (`{server}/Items/{id}/Images/
  Primary?maxHeight=300&api_key=…`, verified working); local files show a file glyph plus the size and
  runtime. Card shows title, subtitle, duration; hover reveals `Play` and `Queue` actions.
- Empty states per source: not signed in (`Connect Jellyfin`), signed in but empty (`Nothing in this
  library yet`), and no search results.
- Keyboard: `/` focuses search, `Esc` closes, arrows move, `Enter` plays. Pointer does everything too.
- One badge per card for the kind (film / note / broadcast) so music and live items are legible before
  the adapters exist.

**C. Where it is reachable from.**

- Home: replace `Choose file…` / `Jellyfin` inline links with one `Pick media` action that opens the
  library; keep drag-and-drop of a local file as the fast path. Choosing an item sets the room copy the
  same way today's pickers do.
- Room: the queue's `Add` opens the library in **queue mode** (a `Queue this` action instead of `Play`,
  and no closing on pick so several can be added).
- A `Library` entry in the Home brand column so the section is reachable on its own, not only mid-join.

**D. Diagrams of intent, not a rewrite.** The existing Jellyfin dialog becomes the sign-in form inside
the library's Jellyfin source (`ensureReady`). Local file picking stays the OS dialog when the user has
no library to browse.

## Constraints

- No protocol, clock, drift, or intent changes; `item_ref` formats stay as they are.
- Candy palette and the existing widget vocabulary; no new fonts or packages.
- Tests: model/ref round-trip for both sources, tab list honours registered sources, search filters,
  empty states, queue mode does not close on pick, and the keyboard paths. Goldens: library with
  Jellyfin posters and library in queue mode, at 1440×900 and 856×1038.
- `flutter test` green, `flutter analyze` no new issues, `flutter build linux --debug` passes.

## Do not

- Do not invent a YouTube or music adapter in this pass. Disabled tabs and the model are the whole
  point; shipping a stub that lies is worse than an honest `Soon`.

Report: the model as built, how sources register, screenshots/golden paths, test count, and the parts you
deliberately deferred.

TASK21 is done. All 170 tests pass, the analyzer has nothing new, and `flutter build linux --debug` builds. The one analyzer note left is the `containsSemantics` deprecation in `test/room_view_test.dart:430`, which was there before this task. Nothing is committed yet.

## The model as built (`app/lib/media.dart`)
- **`MediaKind`** `{video, audio, live}` and **`MediaSourceKind`** `{local, jellyfin, youtube, ytm}`. `sourceKindOf(ref)` works out the source from a ref's prefix, so refs on the wire are unchanged (`file:sha256p:…`, `jellyfin:<host>/<id>`).
- **`MediaItem`** (`media.dart:21`): the ref, title, subtitle, kind, source, duration, poster URL and aspect ratio. `mediaMatches(item, query)` does the search.
- **`MediaSource`** (`media.dart:72`) is the abstract base. It has `kind`, `label`, `ready`, `available`, `account`, `emptyHint` and `actions` (`MediaSourceAction`), plus three methods:
  - `browse({query})` lists the items.
  - `ensureReady()` handles sign-in.
  - `open(item)` returns a `Future<LocalCopy?>`.
- **The four adapters:**
  - `LocalMediaSource` lists files opened this session, with a `Choose file…` action.
  - `JellyfinMediaSource` restores the saved session and shows posters. If the server says the token is invalid (HTTP 401), it drops the session. Its `ensureReady` is the old Jellyfin dialog, now just the sign-in form (`showJellyfinSignIn`).
  - `SoonMediaSource` covers YouTube and Music, both marked unavailable.

## How sources register
`mediaSources(local:, jellyfin:)` (`media.dart:104`) returns one entry per adapter, in tab order. The library builds its tabs from that list, so adding a source means writing a `MediaSource` subclass and adding one line there. Home builds the list once and passes it to `RoomScreen`.

## Entry points
- **Home:** a `Pick media` button replaces the old inline links, and drag-and-drop still works. The `Library` chip sits in the brand column.
- **Room:** the queue's Add button opens `showMediaLibrary(mode: LibraryMode.queue)`. In that mode the library stays open after each pick, shows "N queued", and closes with Done or Esc.

## Goldens (`app/test/golden/`)
- New: `library_1440.png`, `library_856.png`, `library_queue_1440.png` and `library_queue_856.png`. The posters are gradients drawn in the test, so no network is needed.
- Regenerated: `home_1440.png` and `home_856.png`, because the Library chip moved to fix a 28px overflow.

## Tests
- **170 in total.** The new file `test/media_library_test.dart` has 18:
  - ref round trips for local and Jellyfin
  - search
  - tab order and Soon behaviour
  - empty states (not signed in, empty, no results)
  - Connect, Play closing the library, and queue mode staying open
  - keyboard: `/`, the arrow keys, Enter (play or queue), Esc
- I also updated `widget_test.dart`, `jellyfin_picker_test.dart` and `room_view_test.dart` for the new flows.

## Deferred
- YouTube and Music have tabs marked Soon, but no adapters behind them.
- Local doesn't scan folders; it only lists files picked this session.
- Jellyfin lists Movies only, up to 100 items, with no paging, series or music.
- Search only filters items already loaded; it doesn't query the server.

`mediaSources(local:, jellyfin:)` (`media.dart:104`) returns one entry per adapter, in tab order. The library builds its tabs from that list, so adding a source means writing a `MediaSource` subclass and adding one line there. Home builds the list once and passes it to `RoomScreen`.

- **Room:** the queue's Add button opens `showMediaLibrary(mode: LibraryMode.queue)`. In that mode the library stays open after each pick, shows "N queued", and closes with Done or Esc.
